reason: The description accurately captures the core logic of finding patterns using the routing tree, handling subrouters, and updating context. However, it incorrectly claims that an empty string is always returned when no matching route can be resolved, while the implementation returns rctx.routePattern which may not be empty.
incorrect_or_misleading_points: Claims that an empty string is returned when no matching route can be resolved, but implementation returns rctx.routePattern (which may be non-empty) when the tree find returns no node.
